rationale: ram_zeroshot-claude-agentic: ram_ckpt_path=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/ram.pth.tar, ram_input_norm=fbp_max, ram_clamp_output=True, ram_finetune=False, ram_finetune_epochs=0, ram_finetune_lr=0.0001, ram_disable_multiscale=True, ram_disable_cudnn=False, ram_use_deepinv_tomo=False, ram_sigma=0.005, ram_factor=0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend=0.3, val_n=214, rationale=iter-5 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol): ONE knob ram_input_norm adjoint_max->fbp_max (all other knobs RETURN to the iter-1 point: ram_factor 0.55, ram_post_fbp_blend 0.3, ram_sigma 0.005, multiscale disabled, finetune OFF). cfg_full audit iters 1-4: ram_input_norm was pinned at adjoint_max since iter-1 and NEVER moved -> it is the one remaining STRUCTURAL inference lever not yet probed (the three already-swept levers are post-hoc linear blend ram_post_fbp_blend [iter-2], internal prox_l2 DC gain ram_factor [iter-3], denoiser noise-conditioning ram_sigma [iter-4]). SEMANTICS (solver_ram.py L360-393): ram_input_norm sets the amplitude scale at which RAMs pretrained denoiser sees its input image; fbp_max normalizes by the FBP-init max (denom=x_init.max) instead of the adjoint-image max -> a DIFFERENT input-distribution amplitude, the last untried structural knob controlling whether the input lands in RAMs training-distribution range. Trajectory under corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric: iter-1 SSIM 0.8611 hr 0.0 (blend0.3/factor0.55/sigma0.005/adjoint_max); iter-2 0.8644 hr 0.0 (blend0.3->0.5, post-hoc linear FBP/RAM mix EXHAUSTED); iter-3 0.8968 hr 0.0 PSNR31.58 (factor0.55->0.2, internal prox_l2 DC gain EXHAUSTED); iter-4 0.9024 hr 0.0 PSNR31.22 (sigma0.005->0.02, denoiser noise-conditioning EXHAUSTED). SSIM climbed 0.861->0.902 yet calibrated headroom stayed pinned at EXACTLY 0.0 throughout (baseline LD-FBP SSIM0.8078, oracle HD-FBP 0.9331; RMSE-sensitive metric keeps RAMs ~31dB PSNR below the LD-FBP floor). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS not CT pixels): (1) prev: hr 0.0 on all of post-hoc blend AND internal prox_l2 gain AND denoiser sigma; best SSIM iter-4 0.9024, best hr 0.0. (2) LIMITER: RAM is a frozen pretrained zero-shot deepinv denoiser that never saw real LDCT helical-rebinned 2304-view fan data; on dense full-view Mayo LD-FBP is already a near-complete inversion, so a foreign-prior denoiser can only redistribute/smooth signal, not add LDCT-specific recoverable structure -> its RMSE stays above the LD-FBP floor -> hr pinned at 0. (3) ONE knob: ram_input_norm adjoint_max->fbp_max (the last untried structural lever, the input amplitude scale). (4) hypothesis: hr stays EXACTLY 0.0 -- input-norm scale does not matter because the foreign prior carries no LDCT-specific signal at any input amplitude; predict hr 0. (5) falsifier: if hr at fbp_max != 0.0 (rises OR drops off the 0.0 floor), RAMs input scale DOES move the calibrated metric and RAM is not purely FBP-bounded; if hr stays 0.0 across blend(iter-2)+prox_l2(iter-3)+sigma(iter-4)+input-norm(iter-5), RAM is CONFIRMED structurally FBP-bounded on dense Mayo across ALL FOUR inference levers -> on the documented path to iter-20 as a structural negative. (6) verdict: this iter DOCUMENTS the ceiling. Budget: only the input-norm scale-mode changes -> zero added compute vs iter-4 (iters 3-4 ran 934.6s/976.2s = 15.6-16.3 min for 214 single forward passes + one op-norm power iter), comfortably inside the HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score budget; sbatch --time=00:30:00 backstop wall (no in-solver wall knob in solver_ram.py). val_n stays 214 (score ALL L277 slices @ 321px detector-geometry FOV). HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted, per-sample-ps (single-val-ps probe, val-only solver), bg_target=truth, 321px FOV DEFAULT (no fov=False).
